proposed_lean_statement: theorem cong_add_one (a b m : ℤ) (_hm : 0 < m) (h : a ≡ b [ZMOD m]) : a + 1 ≡ b + 1 [ZMOD m]

proposed_english: For every natural number n, the sum of the integers from 1 through n (the empty sum when n=0) equals n(n+1)/2.
